(I)--a daughter of दक्ष and one of the ten wives of Dharma;
1: भा.

. १५; वा. ६६. 2; Vi. I. १५. १०५.
her sons were भानवस् of whom Deva- ऋषभ was one.
2: Br.
(II)--a son of Prativyoman and father of दिवा(r)ka. भा. IX. १२. १०.

.
got himself killed in प्रभासा.
3: Ib. XI. ३०. १७.
(IV)--a son of क्रोधा and a Devagandharva. Br.
(VI)--one of the four sons of स्वारोचिष Manu.
(IX)--a son of भार्ग and father of त्रयीसानु. Vi. IV. १६. 3. [page२-552+ २६]
(I)--the son of बृहदश्व and father of प्रतीकाश्व. भा. IX. १२. ११.

(II)--the son of केशिध्वज and father of शतद्युम्न;
1: भा. IX. १३. २१.
brother of शीरध्वज.
2: Br. III. ६४. १८.
(III)--a son of Bharga and father of Tri- भानु. भा. IX. २३. १६-17.
(IV)--a son of कृष्ण and सत्यभामा. भा. X. ६१. १०.
(V)--a son of सीरध्वज Maithila; his brother कुशध्वज, lord of काशि. वा. ८९. १८. Vi.
(I)--the wife of Sagara and mother of Asa- manjasa. M. १२. ३९, ४२.

(II)--the chief among the १०,000 queens of धर्ममूर्ति, the king of बृहत्कल्प; wife of the goldsmith, शौण्ड in previous birth; was born again as queen for her services in connection with a gift of लवणाचल by लीलावती (s.v.). M. ९२. १९-24. [page२-553+ २६]
--the son of बृहदश्व and father of Pra- तीताश्व. वा. ९९. २८४; Vi. IV. २२. 4.
--took part in the defence of द्वारका from शाल्व. भा. X. ७६. १४.
--the observance of the vow leads to the world of the sun. M. १०१. ६०.
